Meme coins are cryptocurrencies inspired by memes or jokes on the Internet and social media. The first meme coin created was Dogecoin (DOGE). Launched in 2013 as a parody, DOGE was inspired by the popular Doge meme of a Japanese Shiba Inu dog.

#Dogecoin (#DOGE) was created in 2013 by software engineers @BillyM2k and @ummjackson. It was inspired by the meme of a Shiba Inu dog and was intended to be a joke cryptocurrency to attract mainstream attention. As a fork of #Litecoin, DOGE adopts the same Proof of Work.
